context: Hina-young writes a wish on tanabata strip with Mei.
purpose: Adult and teen sharing seasonal ritual.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hina, what are you writing on your tanabata strip?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Soft opening—leaning in slightly. Patient pause before the question, like she's watching Hina's face. No rush.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 受験、頑張れますように。
lines.en: I hope I can do my best on the exam.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. A little vulnerable in the admission. Steady on the core wish, then a slight trailing softness at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: It will come true. I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Warm certainty without being preachy. Light touch of conviction. Eyes steady on Hina. A small reassuring smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Will we be able to see the stars?
lines.style: Wonder and slight uncertainty braided together. Soft, lifting at the end like a real question—genuinely curious about the answer, not performing wonder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 七夕、いい夜になりそう。
lines.en: It looks like it's going to be a beautiful Tanabata night.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Speaking as if to herself as much as to Hina. A soft exhale of satisfaction. Present, warm, observing the moment.
